searchText: Do current consensus clients that support the light client apis save the sync committee attestations for each block? I want to add an endpoint to get sync committee attestations for a specific block, but not sure if anybody has saved these historic attestations, or were they discarded because they were considered ephemeral <etan_status> the cnonical one you can find in the subsequent block's `sync_aggregate`. but anything that's not included there is discarded in nimbus case Thanks for the info about Nimbus, does anyone know the situation in Lodestar's implementation? Hi Everyone. Im trying to sync in my brain what is the state of light nodes future seen today by community? Are there any roadmap for broad adaption of these in some future? I wrote up some thoughts on how this could be tackled in research forum https://ethresear.ch/t/economics-for-p2p-rpc-data-marketplace/17214 Would love to hear feedback.
